verdicts.rationale: The lockfile bumps httpx 0.27->0.28 and httpcore 1.0->1.1; the alert describes broken connection pool reuse after an HTTP client upgrade, and the bump deployed 35 minutes before the latency doubled. The orders->inventory calls go through this client.
Adds retries to fetch_inventory (services/orders/http_client.py) which could amplify latency under retry storms, but it landed 10h before the regression started.
Test-only change (services/orders/tests/e2e.py); not shipped in the runtime path.
